title: Warehouse Management System Incident Response
description: Warehouse Management System incidents affecting food distribution
triggers: Complete WMS outage affecting food distribution
immediate_actions: Assess impact on food distribution and inventory management
Notify Coastal Foods IT Operations team
Implement manual warehouse procedures if needed
Contact distribution management for operational impact assessment
investigation_steps: Review WMS application logs and status
Verify network connectivity to warehouse systems
resolution_steps: Restart WMS services following standard procedures
Implement database fixes or restart if needed
Apply WMS patches or configuration changes
Coordinate with WMS vendor for complex issues
verification: Test WMS functionality at affected warehouses
Confirm with warehouse staff that system is operational
escalation_contacts: Escalation Group: Coastal Foods IT Operations
special_considerations: Warehouse management is critical for food distribution
Food safety regulations may apply to distribution processes
Manual procedures may impact food quality and distribution timelines
Coordinate with distribution management for minimal disruption
